protocol.capability: Capability tokens — HMAC authority for browser→server Intents.
protocol.encode: encode_result — lift Python return values into Result.
protocol.error_map: Error plane — codes → HTTP status, client kind, batch envelope status.
protocol.jsonutil: JSON safety helpers (depth / breadth limits for untrusted Intent args).
protocol.ops: Ops — client apply instructions inside a Result.
protocol.serde: JSON helpers — thin re-export of ``ux_channel.wire`` dumps/loads.

host.actions_file: File-based action discovery — plug-and-play action modules.
host.catalog: Action catalog — machine-readable registry metadata for docs / codegen / OpenAPI
host.day1: Day-1 public surface — prefer this import style for new application code.
host.dx: Channel — the app-facing façade for ux-channel.
host.factory: High-level factory — production and development bootstrap.
host.flow: Flow — product verbs on Channel: on, done, fail, refresh.
host.idempotency: Idempotency store for safe action retries.
host.live: Live plane — in-process topic → region bindings.
host.recipes: Named recipes — copy-paste day-1 patterns (low cognitive load).
host.region_cli: CLI handlers for opt-in file-based regions.
host.region_component: Class-style Region components — ux-dom-adjacent, low ceremony.
host.region_directory: RegionDirectory — opt-in file/package discovery for Region workplaces.
host.regions: Regions — morphable SSR slots with stable identity.
host.registry: ActionRegistry — the dispatch kernel of ux-channel.
host.ssr_state: ``ssr_state`` — session values (server draft) that drive region re-paint.
host.state: State / draft stores — ephemeral UI memory, not your database.
host.state_api: Channel state — day-1 flat API (session · client · db guards).
host.testing: ChannelTest — low-ceremony tests for actions without raw Intent JSON.

paint.demo: Demo / SSR HTML adapters — **the only module that emits markup strings**.
paint.html: HTML wiring helpers — attributes and demo tags, not a design system.
paint.html_document: Document / runtime **Placement** for Channel (no HTML strings).
paint.html_safe: HTML escaping helpers (SafeHtml, esc, mark_safe) for channel render paths.
paint.morph_ir: Morph IR — host-agnostic UI structure for multi-surface projection.
paint.render: HtmlRenderer protocol — turn *any* library's values into HTML fragments.
paint.slot_compile: Stable slot/uid compile from host-agnostic tree dicts.

security_plane.attenuate: Cap attenuation — child capabilities may only narrow parent authority.
security_plane.bulkhead: Bulkhead / concurrency limiter — protect the channel under sudden load spikes.
security_plane.host_csrf: Host CSRF forwarding (optional) + stable channel CSRF (**ux-channel** 0.1).
security_plane.policy: Policy hooks — optional allow/deny for actions and topics (Wave 5).
security_plane.push_security: SSE / push subscribe authorization — production-ready doors for GET /push/{topic
security_plane.ratelimit: Rate limiting for action endpoints — protect heavy-lifting apps under load.
security_plane.security: HTTP-layer and apply-op security helpers (hardened after adversarial review).
security_plane.security_events: Structured security event stream — Wireshark-like DX for auth doors.
security_plane.tree_cap: Capability-shaped documents — envelopes attenuate down the tree.

transport.backoff: Backoff strategies for retries (batch, clients, workers).
transport.batch: Batch dispatch — multiple Intents, one HTTP round-trip.
transport.cors: CORS helper for browser apps that call Channel from a separate frontend origin.
transport.intent_sync: Real-time intent sync across workers (Redis pub/sub).
transport.middleware: ASGI middleware helpers for production DX (request IDs, optional client version)
transport.outbox: Intent outbox — queue Intents when the channel/mesh cannot apply them yet.
transport.stream: SSE streaming of Result chunks — progressive apply for long actions.
transport.ws_protocol: WebSocket message helpers for uxchannel duplex channel.

foundations.io_channel: I/O channel — authorize and record I/O intents; never own device buses.
foundations.provenance: Provenance — durable source stamps for sensitive values.

realtime.media: Media plane bridge — mesh + battle-tested SFU (LiveKit) as one DX.
realtime.sfu: SFU adapter surface (P2) — pluggable bridge to external media servers.
realtime.webrtc_http: HTTP helpers for the WebRTC plane — keep FastAPI routes thin.
realtime.webrtc_ui: WebRTC **plugin** surface — framework-agnostic, no UI chrome.
realtime.whip: WHIP / WHEP-inspired HTTP helpers for uxchannel (optional plane).

bridge_meta.bridge_api: Bridge API — npm widget hosts (not regions).
bridge_meta.bridge_contract: Bridge contracts — how unknown npm APIs become knowable without FFI.
bridge_meta.bridge_plane: Bridge plane — npm **widget** hosts as **data + ops** (not HTML).
bridge_meta.bridge_preset_gen: Automate bridge **preset** creation (adapter + contract + Python façade).
bridge_meta.bridge_protocol: Sealed bridge protocols — guest islands may only use declared methods/events.
bridge_meta.bridge_scaffold: Scaffold npm widget bridges — any package via string ops (not FFI).
bridge_meta.bridge_style: Host chrome for bridge islands — class / style / CSS variables.
bridge_meta.guest_runtime: Sealed guest runtime — islands may paint, not invent durable quantities.
bridge_meta.plugins: Plugin system — plug-and-play integration points for ux-channel.

ops_dx.agent_peer: Agent peer Intent path — internal to AX (``agents_api``).
ops_dx.audit: Audit — intent log + forensics as one attach.
ops_dx.codegen: Minimal TypeScript client codegen from ActionRegistry (optional power).
ops_dx.dx_dashboard: DX Dashboard — observe-only operator surface for **ux-channel**.
ops_dx.dx_errors: DX / CLI exceptions — cognitively consistent, never silent failures.
ops_dx.dx_log: DX console logging — nothing silent; text or structured JSON for automation.
ops_dx.enterprise: Enterprise helpers — multi-tenant safety nets for production apps.
ops_dx.explain: Teachable failures — map error codes / results to recipes and fixes.
ops_dx.forensics: Forensic frames — reconstruct what was painted after an Intent.
ops_dx.info: Package / runtime info for /version endpoints and diagnostics.
ops_dx.inspect_api: Live UX · AX · DX inspect — read-only, principal-scoped, prod-closed by default.
ops_dx.intent_log: Intent log — ordered record of dispatched Intents (support / audit).
ops_dx.observability: Logging and metrics hooks for production observability.
ops_dx.profiling: Internal / maintainer profiling helpers (not a day-1 user API).
ops_dx.schema_models: Optional Pydantic models for OpenAPI / typed Intent-Result (extra: pydantic).
ops_dx.ticket_revoke: Ticket revocation — logout / ban kills live push tickets.
ops_dx.trace: Action & bridge tracing — Wireshark-like DX for the Channel protocol.
ops_dx.upgrade_check: Scan a project tree for outdated / high-cognitive-load patterns.

wire.core: Core wire codec: formats, JSON engines, process policy.
wire.negotiate: HTTP Accept / Content-Type negotiation and body encode/decode.

asgi.core: Pure ASGI Channel endpoint — framework-agnostic host core.
asgi.fastapi: FastAPI host adapter — production-capable Channel HTTP surface.
asgi.pipeline: Shared HTTP preflight for POST /action — one policy for FastAPI + Starlette.
asgi.starlette: Starlette host adapter — security parity with FastAPI (next steps).

bridges._factory: Shared factory + commit helpers for bridge presets.
bridges.aurora: Aurora / mesh-gradient background bridge — cinematic full-bleed motion.
bridges.codemirror: CodeMirror 6-style editor bridge (CDN adapter) — code UIs for ux-dom.
bridges.confetti: Confetti effect bridge — celebration bursts without writing canvas code.
bridges.countup: Count-up / metric ticker bridge — animated numbers for dashboards.
bridges.datepicker: Flatpickr date/time bridge — scheduling and forms.
bridges.generic: Generic island bridge — wrap **any** npm / adapter package for any HTML host.
bridges.leaflet: Leaflet map bridge — high-value for location UIs (ux-dom host).
bridges.lottie: Lottie animation bridge — stunning motion from JSON/CDN.
bridges.mermaid: Mermaid diagram bridge — architecture & flow diagrams in ux-dom.
bridges.particles: Particle field bridge — ambient interactive particles for hero UIs.
bridges.quill: Quill rich-text bridge — documents and comments.
bridges.select: Searchable select bridge (Tom Select-compatible adapter) — forms that feel nativ
bridges.sortable: SortableJS list bridge — drag-and-drop reordering for ux-dom lists.
bridges.spotlight: Spotlight / glass-glow hover effect for premium card UIs.
bridges.swiper: Swiper carousel bridge — galleries and marketing carousels.

components.badge: Badge — simple count/status pill that morphs in place.
components.compose: Composition — Block + Composite on top of ChannelComponent (still 1 MRO step).
components.composites: Complex composites — Channel widgets + slots for ux-dom / other libraries.
components.confirm: ConfirmButton — dangerous once-cap action with optional modal.
components.flash: Flash / banner region for persistent messages.
components.form: Validated form component — fields, errors, focus, toast.
components.primitive: Bare-bones Channel region primitives — library-agnostic (Tailwind-like utilities
components.slots: Slot composition patterns for Channel Components.

agents.audit: Agent audit log — every tool call is attributable in production.
agents.policy: Agent / MCP policy — production guardrails for non-human callers.
agents.runner: Safe agent/MCP tool runner — the only path agents should use to hit actions.
agents.session: AgentSession — scoped identity + budgets for agent/MCP callers.
agents.tools: Map Channel actions → agent/MCP tool definitions (JSON Schema-ish).

mcp.adapter: MCP-shaped adapter (Model Context Protocol tool surface).
mcp.annotations: Enrich MCP tool descriptors with vertical / outbox / I/O annotations.
mcp.asgi_routes: HTTP routes for agent/MCP tool access (modular mount).
mcp.confirm: Signed confirmation tokens for MCP / agent high-stakes tools.
mcp.resources: MCP resources — read-only context (situation, region, claim, verticals).
mcp.subscribe: MCP resource subscribe — invalidate/notify over the channel push bus (SSE).
mcp.verticals: Vertical packs — installable MCP product slices.

workplace.mesh: Mesh membership — WebRTC door + Workplace policy as one issuance.
workplace.room: Workplace room façade — claim · gate · AX · I/O (package-private module).
workplace.ticket: Workplace tickets — signed membership for policy-shaped rooms.
